card.name: Warning-text nouns before safety details
card.fires_on: Nouns or verbs that end a short warning or adverse-event phrase, such as children, products, overdose, injury, reported. They sit in label warning text just before the detail of what happened or what to do.

modes.label: The keep-out warning
modes.description: The word children or products in the standard accidental overdose warning.
modes.example: WARNING: Keep out of the reach of<< children>>. In case of accidental overdose, seek

modes.label: Adverse event reports
modes.description: Words like injury, reported, or of in postmarketing case-report sentences.
modes.example: Cases of methemoglobinemia have been<< reported>> in association with local anesthetic use.

card.plain: It marks the key word in a label warning or adverse-event sentence, just before the details follow.
